node: Precision optical substrates and materials for 800G/1.6T transceivers
summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around the optical-substrate and photonics-materials chokepoint for AI data-center interconnects. The strongest underfollowed direct substrate candidate found in this pass is AXT Inc., because it discloses InP, GaAs and Ge substrate exposure and explicitly links InP to fiber optics, data-center connectivity and AI infrastructure demand. Coherent is included as the reference anchor because it is vertically integrated in InP and 800G/1.6T optics, but its market attention is now high. Aeluma is included as a speculative shadow candidate because its silicon-based III-V platform could matter if native InP substrate capacity remains constrained, but commercial qualification evidence needs verification. Fabrinet is included as a second-order qualification/manufacturing gate rather than a substrate supplier, because high-speed transceiver manufacturing scale and customer concentration can reveal demand pull-through from the substrate layer. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
